meta.title: Shemoqmedi: the web's finest work, judged by creators
meta.description: Designers and developers submit their best websites, an independent jury scores them, and the finest are awarded every day.

hero.title: The web's finest work, judged by creators.
hero.lead: Submit your best website. An independent jury of designers and developers scores it, and the finest work is awarded every day.

criteria.designDesc: Layout, typography, colour and visual consistency.
criteria.craftDesc: Speed, accessibility and the quality of the build.
criteria.originalityDesc: A clear idea that we haven't seen a hundred times.
criteria.contentDesc: Writing, imagery and how well it serves the visitor.

shortlist.label: Shortlist
shortlist.title: Nominees the jury is scoring now

awards.label: Awards
awards.title: How a site gets awarded
awards.lead: Every submission is scored by an independent jury on four weighted criteria. Speed counts: craft is almost a third of the score.

submit.title: Submit
submit.text: Send your live website with screenshots, credits and the tools you used.

jury.title: Jury scores
jury.text: Jury members score each criterion from 1 to 10 within seven days.

daily.title: Creation of the day
daily.text: The highest-scoring site of the day is featured on the front page.

annual.title: Month and year
annual.text: Daily winners go on to the monthly and annual awards.

cta.title: Your work deserves a jury.
cta.lead: Create a free account, submit your website and get honest scores from people who build the web.

footer.tagline: shemoqmedi is a space for creators: a showcase of the web's finest work, judged by the people who build it.

account.title: Your account
account.description: You are registered. Submissions open soon.
account.convexUnauthenticated: Signed in to Clerk, but Convex did not accept the token. Check that this app uses the same Clerk instance as the Convex deployment.
